title: Wooden Valley Winery
specs: Wines from diverse microclimates and soil types of Suisun Valley
Family-owned for three generations with Lanza-style hospitality
Guests of all ages welcome; children must be supervised at all times
Maximum 12 guests per tasting table; picnic tables accommodate up to 8 guests
The Terrazzo accommodates up to 20 guests
Mario's Room accommodates up to 12 guests

options.name: Picnicking
options.detail: Outdoor picnic table reservation for groups of 1-8

variants.label: Outdoor picnic table reservation for groups of 1-8

includes: Four bottles of wine included with The Terrazzo and Mario's Room reservations
blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings featuring five samples over 90 minutes, picnic with their own food paired with winery wines, or reserve private outdoor and indoor spaces for groups. The winery emphasizes family hospitality and showcases wines from the Suisun Valley appellation. Reservations are recommended for groups of five or more.
extraNote: Reservations highly recommended for groups of five or more, max 12 people · Wine tasting and bottle opening end at 4:00 pm daily · Guests must vacate premises by 5 pm · No outside alcohol, smoking, or vaping allowed · Picnic table reservations required for picnicking
